title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nadesan shares his love plan with Nila while the family advises Cheran and Chandayatha to travel alone. Chozhan and the family celebrate Nila's construction achievement.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Ragavan urges Bagyaraj to bring Malar home to manage household chores. However, Bagyaraj struggles with the loneliness of being apart from Malar and longs to reunite with her.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Aishwarya suspects Eshwari's role in camp issues and reveals the truth behind the information leak to Tamizhselvi. Later, she warns Eshwari about exposing her past crime.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Late into the night, Madhu extends her support to help Arjun craft his sales presentation. Elsewhere, Karthik looks after Kasthuri by serving her dinner after a long wait.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Rajeshwari faces difficulty settling Maha's debts after learning her asset value. Meanwhile, Kanmani looks for a way to access Anbu's laptop to learn about the business expo.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Everyone thanks Indhira for securing mess salaries from Kandhasamy. Murugan gifts her a saree from his first pay, praises her selfless nature, and they spend quality time together.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Thangamayil confides her desire to reunite with Saravanan to Meena. Gomathi suggests the same, but Saravanan gets tensed when Senthil brings it up.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Shruthi and Meena visit Parvathy's home to discuss a plan to make Vijaya perform atonement for Rohini. Later, Seetha secures a business order for Meena through an acquaintance.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Heavy rain leaves Vetri stranded at the office with Sandhya as he helps with project work. Sudar grows anxious when he fails to return home, while Shanmugam consoles her.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar stays silent to hide his drinking while Poongodi is moved by Mayandi's painful jail struggles. Pechi grieves and ponders the past murder of Manjamalai's father with Kaliammal.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi and Paraman secretly take money from Kalamma's locker for Manikandan. Sidharth later accuses Ganthimathi and Kumaresan after seeing them buy a gold ring for Paraman.
